mapper.insert: INSERT INTO odin_formation_run_frames ( guid, run_guid, formation_guid, group_guid, task_guid, task_name, page_no, frame_no, queue_type, frame_status, priority ) VALUES ( #{frame.guid}, #{frame.runGuid}, #{frame.formationGuid}, #{frame.groupGuid}, #{frame.taskGuid}, #{frame.taskName}, #{frame.pageNo}, #{frame.frameNo}, #{frame.queueType}, #{frame.frameStatus}, #{frame.priority} )
mapper.select: SELECT id, guid, run_guid, formation_guid, group_guid, task_guid, task_name, page_no, frame_no, queue_type, frame_status, priority, instance_guid, claim_owner, claim_token, lease_expire_time, submit_time, finish_time, attempt_count, error_cause FROM odin_formation_run_frames WHERE run_guid = #{runGuid} AND page_no = #{pageNo} AND frame_status = 'Pending' ORDER BY frame_no ASC

SELECT id, guid, run_guid, formation_guid, group_guid, task_guid, task_name, page_no, frame_no, queue_type, frame_status, priority, instance_guid, claim_owner, claim_token, lease_expire_time, submit_time, finish_time, attempt_count, error_cause FROM odin_formation_run_frames WHERE run_guid = #{runGuid} AND frame_status = 'Pending' ORDER BY priority DESC, frame_no ASC, id ASC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE odin_formation_run_frames SET frame_status = 'Claimed', claim_owner = #{claimOwner}, claim_token = #{claimToken}, lease_expire_time = DATE_ADD(NOW(), INTERVAL #{leaseSeconds} SECOND) WHERE guid = #{guid} AND frame_status = 'Pending'
mapper.sql: id, guid, run_guid, formation_guid, group_guid, task_guid, task_name, page_no, frame_no, queue_type, frame_status, priority, instance_guid, claim_owner, claim_token, lease_expire_time, submit_time, finish_time, attempt_count, error_cause
mapper.update: UPDATE odin_formation_run_frames SET frame_status = 'Submitted', instance_guid = #{instanceGuid}, submit_time = NOW(), attempt_count = attempt_count + 1 WHERE guid = #{guid} AND frame_status IN ('Pending', 'Claimed')
UPDATE odin_formation_run_frames SET frame_status = 'Completed', finish_time = NOW() WHERE guid = #{guid} AND frame_status = 'Submitted'

UPDATE odin_formation_run_frames SET frame_status = 'Failed', finish_time = NOW(), attempt_count = attempt_count + IF(frame_status IN ('Pending', 'Claimed'), 1, 0), error_cause = #{errorCause} WHERE guid = #{guid} AND frame_status IN ('Pending', 'Claimed', 'Submitted')
UPDATE odin_formation_run_frames SET frame_status = 'Completed', finish_time = NOW() WHERE instance_guid = #{instanceGuid} AND frame_status = 'Submitted'
